# `silk/json/schema_resolver`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Caller-replaceable JSON Schema document resolution during compilation.

## Details
Provide `SchemaResolver` to `Schema.compile`. The compiler requests absolute, fragment-free
retrieval URIs and owns returned trees. Validation never calls this service. No filesystem
or network provider is installed implicitly. Providers may bind their own I/O dependencies.
Use `SchemaRegistry` for reusable, explicitly registered in-memory documents.

Import as `SchemaResolver` with `import silk.json.schema_resolver { SchemaResolver }`.

<a id="SchemaResolver"></a>

## `SchemaResolver`

```silk
pub service SchemaResolver
```

Resolves external schemas and custom metaschemas for `Schema.compile`.

### Details
Implementations return an owned tree, transferring it to the compiler. Each requested
retrieval URI is cached for one compilation; indexed local resources need no provider call.
A provider can be dropped after compilation, before validation.

<a id="SchemaResolver.resolve"></a>

### Operation `resolve`

```silk
effect fn resolve(uri: string) -> Option<Value>
    ! SchemaResolutionError | OutOfMemoryError ? &mut SchemaResolver | &mut Allocator
```

Resolves an absolute URI without a fragment. `None` means the document is unavailable.

#### Errors
- `SchemaResolutionError` for provider failures, such as denied or failed I/O.
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the provider cannot allocate the returned document.

<a id="SchemaRegistry"></a>

## `SchemaRegistry`

```silk
pub struct SchemaRegistry
```

An explicit in-memory resolver that owns registered schemas and is reusable across compilations.
Resolution copies the selected document once, preserving exact numbers and object order.

Returns an empty provider; every URI is unavailable until a schema is added.

<a id="SchemaRegistry.impl.add"></a>

### Method `add`

```silk
pub effect fn add(self: &mut Self, uri: string, schema: Value) -> ()
    ! OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Registers `schema` under the absolute, fragment-free retrieval `uri`, taking ownership.
An existing entry with the same URI is replaced. Resolution also recognizes a document's
absolute `$id` or draft-4 `id` after removing its fragment.

#### Errors
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the registry cannot store the URI or entry.
